summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing business milestones: delivery of Pro6000 servers worth US$31 million to Digital Dynamic Inc. (DDI) via its Japan Global Supply Center, with cumulative shipments expected to reach US$38 million by end of August 2026. This is an operational update regarding procurement contracts and purchase orders, not a special situation. The filing discloses routine commercial activity, contract wins, and delivery progress. No board action, shareholder vote, or structural change is involved. The registrant is the filer reporting ordinary business developments.
